page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Heading in capitals across the top. Below it a framed engraving in the centre. Below the engraving, a four-line verse set centred in italic. Catchword at the lower right.

p.i: O laudis stimule! ô malè quid mortalia cogis Pectora; vel summum deseruisse Deum! Hoc age, & hoc sape, quod diuino munere gratis Concessum est, ita Iouæq; frueris ope.

page.notes: The engraving shows a pedestal with a glass vessel bearing a bee, and above it a globe containing a figure reading at a desk with a book and flying bees, set against clouds and a landscape with a town. The verse "malè" and "Iouæq;" are doubtful: the accent over the e and the reading of the first letters of the last line are not clear, so they are uncertain. The engraving has no text of its own. The text is left as printed where the scan is faint.
